name: Audit: Performance
description: Analyzes performance configuration, cache settings, cache modules status, and detects cache issues in custom code.
project_description: audit_performance registers the `performance` AuditAnalyzer plugin (PerformanceAnalyzer). It scores production readiness (error-display level, Twig debug/auto-reload, CSS/JS aggregation, page/dynamic-page cache, BigPipe), inspects the state of cache-related contrib modules (delegating discovery to audit_modules), and statically scans the custom-code scan directories for cache-bubbling and performance anti-patterns (e.g. `file_get_contents()`/`fopen()` on variable URIs, direct DB queries where entity API is preferred, leftover debug code). Findings surface as scored issue sections plus informational status tables on the Performance detail page.
